actions.name: make_OK_sign
actions.text: a person raises the right hand to shoulder height in front and holds it still
paraphrases: a person lifts one hand beside the face and keeps it raised briefly
a person brings the right hand up to shoulder level and pauses with it
a person holds the right hand up near the face, then lowers it
actions.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to shoulder or face height, in front of or slightly to the side of the body. The hand is held still for a moment, upright with the palm facing forward. The arm then lowers back to the side while the rest of the body stays still.

phases.start: right hand rises from the side
phases.middle: hand held still at shoulder height

not_observable: thumb and index finger forming a ring

confusable_with.name: make_victory_sign
confusable_with.visible_difference: same raised and held hand; differs only in finger shape, which is barely visible

confusable_with.name: thumb_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand is a closed fist pushed forward at chest height with the thumb tip above it

confusable_with.name: hand_waving
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand moves side to side repeatedly instead of being held still

actions.name: make_victory_sign
actions.text: a person raises the right hand near the face and holds it upright
paraphrases: a person lifts one hand to head height with fingers up and pauses
a person brings the right hand up beside the face and keeps it still
a person holds an upright hand raised near the shoulder, then lowers it
actions.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to shoulder or head height, beside or in front of the face. The hand is held upright and still for a moment, with the hand tip above the wrist. The arm then lowers back to the side; the head may tilt slightly toward the hand.

phases.start: right hand rises from the side
phases.middle: upright hand held still near the face

not_observable: index and middle fingers spread in a V shape

confusable_with.name: make_OK_sign
confusable_with.visible_difference: same raised and held hand; differs only in finger shape, which is barely visible

confusable_with.name: taking_a_selfie
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand is stretched forward and up away from the face, often for longer

confusable_with.name: salute
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand touches the side of the forehead with the elbow raised out to the side

actions.name: staple_book
actions.text: a person presses the right hand down repeatedly on top of the left hand
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together in front and pushes down with the right hand
a person holds the hands together at waist level and presses down with one palm
a person pushes the right hand downward on the left hand once or twice
actions.motion: Both hands come together in front of the body at waist or table height, with the left hand below and the right hand on top. The right hand and arm push sharply downward, sometimes with the shoulders and torso leaning over the hands, and the press may repeat a few times. Between presses the hands shift slightly, then both hands lower.

phases.start: both hands meet in front at waist height
phases.middle: right hand presses sharply down on the left

confusable_with.name: counting_money
confusable_with.visible_difference: the right hand makes small sliding motions rather than sharp downward presses

confusable_with.name: cutting_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: the right hand makes small repeated motions while moving forward, not pressing down

confusable_with.name: clapping
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet side to side repeatedly at chest height rather than one pressing on the other

actions.name: counting_money
actions.text: a person holds both hands together in front and moves one hand repeatedly
paraphrases: a person keeps both hands close at chest height and makes small repeated hand motions
a person holds the left hand still and repeatedly moves the right hand across it
a person makes small repeated sliding motions of one hand over the other hand
actions.motion: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest or waist, with the left hand mostly still. The right hand makes small repeated movements across or away from the left hand, mainly at the wrist, in a steady rhythm. The head tilts slightly down and the arms and torso stay mostly still.

phases.start: both hands brought together in front
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated motions over the left

confusable_with.name: play_with_phone_tablet
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands hold still together with even smaller motions and the head bent lower

confusable_with.name: play_magic_cube
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands twist and turn together instead of one hand sliding over the other

confusable_with.name: reading
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands hold still in front with only occasional page-turning movements

actions.name: cutting_nails
actions.text: a person holds one hand still while the other hand works closely on its fingers
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together near the chest and moves one in small pinches
a person keeps the hands close at chest height, one making small squeezing motions
a person bends the head down over both hands held close and moving slightly
actions.motion: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest or waist, and the head bends down toward them. The right hand makes small repeated squeezing motions near the fingertips of the left hand, and the left hand may turn or shift slightly between cuts. The arms stay bent and the body stays still; the hands may switch roles partway.

phases.start: hands come together in front, head bends down
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated squeezes at the left fingertips

confusable_with.name: counting_money
confusable_with.visible_difference: the right hand slides across the left in a steady rhythm rather than pausing between squeezes

confusable_with.name: cutting_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands are farther apart and the right hand moves forward along a path

confusable_with.name: apply_cream_on_hand
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand rubs over the back and palm of the other with larger circular motions

actions.name: cutting_paper
actions.text: a person holds both hands apart in front while one hand makes repeated snipping motions
paraphrases: a person holds the left hand forward and moves the right hand along it repeatedly
a person keeps both hands in front of the chest and makes small cutting motions
a person advances the right hand slowly forward with small repeated squeezing motions
actions.motion: Both hands are raised in front of the chest a short distance apart, with the left hand mostly holding still. The right hand makes small repeated wrist and forearm motions while slowly moving forward or around near the left hand, and the left hand may turn. The head tilts down toward the hands and the body stays still.

phases.start: both hands raised in front of the chest
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated motions while advancing

confusable_with.name: cutting_nails
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands are closer together and the right hand stays at the left fingertips

confusable_with.name: fold_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands move together toward and away from each other and press flat

confusable_with.name: staple_book
confusable_with.visible_difference: the right hand presses sharply down on the left instead of advancing with small motions

actions.name: snap_fingers
actions.text: a person raises one hand in front and makes a quick small flick with it
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to chest height and gives a sharp flick
a person brings one hand up and makes a short quick wrist motion
a person holds the right hand raised and gives a sudden small downward flick
actions.motion: The right arm bends and the right hand rises to chest or shoulder height in front of or beside the body. The hand makes one or a few short, quick movements, mostly at the wrist, with little arm movement. The rest of the body stays still and the arm then lowers.

phases.middle: one or a few quick wrist flicks

confusable_with.name: thumb_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand is held still without a quick flick

confusable_with.name: hand_waving
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand moves side to side repeatedly with larger arm motion

confusable_with.name: make_OK_sign
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand is held still near the face rather than flicked

actions.name: open_bottle
actions.text: a person holds both hands together in front and twists one hand repeatedly
paraphrases: a person holds the left hand still and turns the right hand above it
a person brings both hands together at chest height and rotates the upper hand
a person twists the right wrist back and forth above the left hand in front
actions.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest or waist, one above the other, with the left hand lower and still. The right hand twists back and forth with repeated wrist rotations, and the right elbow may lift slightly to the side. Finally the right hand moves up and away from the left hand.

phases.start: hands meet one above the other in front
phases.middle: right wrist twists back and forth repeatedly
phases.end: right hand lifts away from the left

confusable_with.name: rub_two_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: palms slide against each other side by side instead of one hand twisting above the other

confusable_with.name: play_magic_cube
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands turn together with the hands side by side

confusable_with.name: open_a_box
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands pull apart or lift outward rather than one wrist twisting

actions.name: sniff_smell
actions.text: a person brings one hand up close to the nose and holds it there
paraphrases: a person raises the right hand to the face and leans the head toward it
a person lifts a hand under the nose and pauses with the head bent slightly
a person moves one hand to the front of the nose, then lowers it
actions.motion: The right hand rises to just below or in front of the nose, and the head bends slightly forward or down toward it. The hand and head stay close together for a moment, with possible small head movements. The hand then lowers back to the side; sometimes both hands rise together to the face.

phases.start: right hand rises toward the face
phases.middle: hand held at the nose with the head bent toward it

confusable_with.name: drink_water
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand reaches the mouth and the head tilts back

confusable_with.name: hush
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand stops at the mouth and the head does not bend toward it

confusable_with.name: blow_nose
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands cover the nose with small repeated head jerks

actions.name: squat_down
actions.text: a person bends both knees deeply and lowers the hips toward the floor
paraphrases: a person lowers the body into a crouch by bending the legs fully
a person squats, bringing the hips down near the heels with the torso upright
a person crouches low with knees bent and arms often reaching forward
actions.motion: Starting from standing, both knees and hips bend and the hips move straight down toward the heels while the feet stay in place. The torso leans slightly forward and the arms often reach forward or rest on the knees for balance. The person holds the low crouch and may then stand back up.

phases.middle: knees and hips bend, hips drop toward the heels
phases.end: held low crouch, possibly rising again

confusable_with.name: sit_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: hips move back onto a seat and stop higher, with the torso leaning back

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: torso bends forward, one hand reaches the floor, and the person stands quickly

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_shoe
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands work at one foot for a while, often with one leg raised
